previousModel.purpose: Frozen descriptive baseline on the exact same final 23-task gallery; never used for selection.

configuration.initialization: Fresh parameters and fresh Adam state per fold, ablation, and final full-development fit; same declared seed.
configuration.architecture: Unchanged two-layer relation-aware GNN; hidden/output 24; shared COBOL/Java encoder.
configuration.objective: Symmetric paired-source InfoNCE, temperature 0.12; in-batch negatives only from current fitting fold.
configuration.selection: Pooled 120 out-of-fold reciprocal ranks (MRR), then query-weighted validation loss, then earliest checkpoint epoch. No test-based tuning.
configuration.ablation: No-message model has identical capacity, initialization seed, optimizer, epoch budget, folds, and its own identical CV epoch-selection rule.

calibration.reason: Benchmark-only retrieval evidence; financial-domain reliability remains unvalidated. Every ranking requires explicit human review.
calibration.method: Fixed before CV and final evaluation; no holdout threshold selection.

configuration.ties: Stable candidate order saved in the partition plan; equal scores retain that order.
configuration.finalProtocol: Freeze both full-development checkpoints, selected epochs, gate, and CV report before any learned encoding/scoring of the 23 final-holdout tasks. Deterministic graph partitioning may inspect all tasks before fitting. One final evaluation per frozen run.
prohibited: No final-holdout graphs/embeddings/loss/negative-gallery in CV or fitting.
No augmentation, architecture change, threshold search or test-driven hyperparameter search.

priorExposure.limitation: The final 23 are held out from all new fitting/CV/gate choices, but were previously evaluated in v1. They cannot honestly be called pristine unforeseen data. New independently collected tasks are needed for that claim.

limitations: 143 small HumanEval-derived source pairs, not banking migrations.
Pair labels express upstream correspondence, not formal equivalence or defect locations.
Heuristic operation graphs are not full compiler ASTs or control-flow graphs.
Names are excluded from the model; the name-matching baseline can outperform it.
Cosine similarities are not calibrated correctness probabilities.
Final holdout is excluded from this fit and CV, but all 23 tasks were previously evaluated by v1; it is not pristine unseen or external data.
Financial-domain generalization, repair, and defect prediction remain unvalidated.
The selected-epoch out-of-fold results were used for epoch selection; they are exploratory selection evidence, not an unbiased nested-CV generalization estimate.
CV galleries contain 24 candidates; final evaluation contains 23. Metrics from different gallery sizes or earlier 29-task reports are not directly comparable.
